brief: The devops stack that ships features to production in under 10 minutes — 6 tools, real config.

slots.eyebrow: ship faster, deploy safer, sleep better

slots.tagline: The foundation where every feature branch starts its journey to production.
slots.f1Body: Automated test and build pipelines trigger on every pull request instantly.
slots.f2Body: Enforce reviews and status checks before any code reaches the main branch.
slots.f3Body: Connect commits to deployments and notify your team across every channel.

slots.tagline: Package applications into portable containers that run identically across every environment.
slots.f1Body: Compile production images under fifty megabytes for blazing fast startup times.
slots.f2Body: Spin up Postgres, Redis, and APIs with one command during development.
slots.f3Body: Ship immutable images to private registries ready for production orchestration.

slots.tagline: Ship frontend changes to global edge nodes in seconds with zero configuration overhead.
slots.f1Body: Every pull request generates a live staging URL for immediate team review.
slots.f2Body: Cache static assets across two-hundred locations for sub-millisecond global response.
slots.f3Body: Run Node and Python APIs that scale automatically without managing backend servers.

slots.tagline: Managed Postgres with real-time subscriptions and instant APIs for your data layer.
slots.f1Body: Lock down data access with Postgres policies that scale with your user base.
slots.f2Body: Auto-generated REST and GraphQL endpoints eliminate backend boilerplate completely.
slots.f3Body: Fork production schema for testing migrations without risking live customer data.

slots.tagline: Self-hosted automation that triggers deployments and alerts across your entire pipeline.
slots.f1Body: Start workflows from GitHub events or form submissions in real time.
slots.f2Body: Retry failed nodes and notify Slack when production jobs need attention.
slots.f3Body: Keep sensitive data inside your infrastructure instead of third-party cloud automation.

slots.tagline: In-memory store that cuts database load and speeds up API responses tenfold.
slots.f1Body: Manage user authentication state across serverless functions without disk bottlenecks.
slots.f2Body: Protect endpoints from traffic spikes using atomic counter operations per second.
slots.f3Body: Broadcast real-time events to connected clients via lightweight in-memory channels.

slots.ctaBody: Steal this exact toolchain and start shipping production features before your coffee gets cold.
